name: translocated promoter region, nuclear basket protein
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: TPR encodes nucleoprotein TPR. Annotated molecular activities include protein homodimerization activity and structural constituent of nuclear pore. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and nucleocytoplasmic transport.

germline.text: The reviewed GenCC assertions do not establish a conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship for this draft; limited or conflicting assertions require separate review.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include NTRK-rearranged spindle cell sarcoma of the uterine cervix / corpus. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
